name: Pertamina ECO Runfest
short_description: A World Athletics Label race through Jakarta, Indonesia, offering distances from 1.5km to a half marathon.
ai_summary: Pertamina ECO Runfest is a World Athletics Label event held in Jakarta, Indonesia, taking place on November 22, 2026. It offers a range of distances from a 1.5km fun run up to a half marathon (21.0975km), making it accessible to both casual participants and competitive runners. As a city-based race in a major capital, it runs through Jakarta's urban streets.
pros: Multiple distance options suit a range of runners, from beginners to half marathoners
World Athletics Label status signals an internationally recognized standard of organization
Takes place in a major capital city, offering an urban race experience

faqs.question: Where and when does the Pertamina ECO Runfest take place?
faqs.answer: The Pertamina ECO Runfest is held in Jakarta, Indonesia, with the event scheduled for November 22, 2026. As a city-based race, the course runs through the streets of Jakarta, one of the region's major capital cities, giving participants an urban running experience.

faqs.question: Is the Pertamina ECO Runfest an internationally recognized race?
faqs.answer: Yes, it carries a World Athletics Label, which is an official designation given to races that meet certain organizational and competitive standards set by the sport's global governing body. This makes it a notable event for runners seeking a certified international race.

faqs.question: What distances can I run at the Pertamina ECO Runfest?
faqs.answer: The event offers four distance options: a 1.5km fun run, a 5km, a 10km, and a half marathon at 21.0975km. This range allows casual participants, families, and more serious competitive runners to all take part in the same event on the same day.
